components.input_conditions: tau>0,p>=2; explicit eta,chi,rho as in construction.
components.parameter_and_cost_changes: Bp depends only on fixed p and fixed gate; no dimension factor.
components.transcript_control: Every complete derivative tensor of a gated rank-one term vanishes when its argument is in the flat interval.
components.transformation: Integrate rho to h_tau. It is odd C-infinity; 0<=h_tau'<=1, |h_tau(s)|<=|s|, |s-h_tau(s)|<=tau, h_tau(s)>=s-tau. h_tau and all derivatives vanish on the closed flat interval, endpoints included. For s>=tau, h_tau(s)=s-b_tau, b_tau=tau integral_0^1(1-rho(u))du in [tau/2,tau].

components.preserved_model_properties: T_V is q-contractive and ball invariant; F_V is C-infinity, lambda/(2m)-strongly monotone and Lip(D^(p-1)F_V)<=Lp independently of d. The strong-monotonicity parameter is not uniform in N. Unique zero has s1=c,s_{i+1}=q h_tau(si), norm between 3R/16 and R/sqrt(3).
components.transcript_control: Public ball and initialization reveal no frame information.
components.transformation: Assemble T_V and F_V in construction.definition.

components.input_conditions: x in the ball, |<vm,x>|<=tau/2; R=D/2 for diameter formulation.
components.parameter_and_cost_changes: Let a=(3p-1)/2 and c_res=1/[2^p 8Bp16^(p-1)]. Obstruction is c_res LpD^p/(N+1)^a. Section11.3 pp30–31 combines it with the source-local Lemma11.5 zero-query interface to obtain T>=max{1,(c_res Q)^(1/a)-1}>=(c_res Q)^(1/a)/2.
components.preserved_model_properties: Outside-frame components of x remain allowed and cannot defeat the projection argument. Smoothness and diameter are normalized before the oracle argument.
support_refs: Source revision1 Section11.3 pp30–31, Lemma11.5 and normalization
components.transcript_control: A hidden final scalar coordinate implies the full tangent-residual obstruction.
components.transformation: Weighted telescoping with wi=q^(m-i) gives ||x-T_V(x)||>=R/(8m). Ball invariance ensures r_tan(x)=||F_V(x)|| even on the boundary.

construction.definition: Use Euclidean norm on R^d and induced multilinear operator norm. eta(t)=exp(-1/t) for t>0 and 0 otherwise; chi(t)=eta(t)/(eta(t)+eta(1-t)); rho(u)=chi((4u^2-1)/3). Thus rho is even C-infinity, valued in [0,1], zero for |u|<=1/2 and one for |u|>=1. Bp=max{1,||rho^(p-1)||_infinity}; h_tau(s)=tau integral_0^(s/tau) rho(u)du. For orthonormal V=(v1,...,vm), T_V(x)=c v1+q sum_{i=1}^{m-1}h_tau(<vi,x>)v_{i+1}; F_V(x)=lambda(x-T_V(x)).
construction.hidden_objects: Only the orthonormal frame V. Deterministic realization constructs a frame against a fixed algorithm; randomized realization draws the full frame uniformly before the run.
construction.parameters: Integer p>=2, Lp,R>0, integer N>=1, m=N+1, integer d>=m; q=1-1/(2m), c=R/(2 sqrt(m)), tau=c/(8m)=R/(16m^(3/2)), lambda=Lp tau^(p-1)/Bp. X=B_2^d(R), x0=0. Calibrate diameter by R=D/2.
construction.public_information: Dimension, ball, x0, p,Lp,R,N and all scalar parameters, gate and operator template may be disclosed. Domain and initialization never depend on V.

hardness_claims.algorithm_coverage: Every adaptive deterministic feasible-query algorithm, arbitrary feasible output including an unqueried output; no span/tensor-update restriction.
hardness_claims.missing_lifting: No noisy-jet or outside-ball lifting supplied.

hardness_claims.algorithm_coverage: Every measurable total-feasible randomized adaptive algorithm with independent seed and at most N queries under a worst-case cap.
hardness_claims.missing_lifting: No O(N)-dimension randomized bound, expected-query-budget theorem or unbounded-probe theorem supplied.
hardness_claims.regime_note: delta in (0,1), d>=m+ceil(2048m^3 log(2(m^2+1)/delta)). At delta=1/4 and obstruction strictly greater than epsilon, some fixed instance contradicts per-instance success>=2/3.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: For each deterministic adaptive algorithm with at most N queries and arbitrary feasible output, choose vt orthogonal to span{v1,...,v_{t-1},x1,...,xt} and answer the jet of F_t(x)=lambda[x-cv1-q sum_{i=1}^{t-1}h_tau(<vi,x>)v_{i+1}]. After the last answer choose v_{N+1} orthogonal also to the output.
oracle_realizations.cost: At most N original-operator complete-jet calls, worst-case cap. Arbitrary internal computations allowed. Early stops padded with ignored feasible queries and saved output retained.
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: For any earlier query xt, all vi with i>=t are orthogonal to xt. Every omitted gate and every derivative vanish exactly, so equality holds for entire returned tensors, without a span or tensor-update restriction.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: Final output obeys <vm,xhat>=0. Hidden-slab property yields r_tan(xhat)>=lambda R/(8m)=Lp R^p/[8Bp 16^(p-1)m^((3p-1)/2)].
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: Any feasible x in X returns (F_V(x),DF_V(x),...,D^(p-1)F_V(x)), the complete tensors, for one oracle call.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: No randomness required. The online answers equal one final fixed admissible F_V on the entire transcript; no changing-instance lower bound is asserted.

oracle_realizations.choices_and_history: Draw one uniform orthonormal m-frame in R^d before the run, independently of the algorithm seed. Measurable query/output maps are feasible on every transcript. Fix a seed and simulate responses using F_t; query t depends only on v1,...,v_{t-1}, and simulated output only on v1,...,vN.
oracle_realizations.cost: Worst-case cap N, not expected stopping time. For delta in (0,1), require d>=m+ceil(2048m^3 log(2(m^2+1)/delta)).
oracle_realizations.information_bottleneck: Each omitted-gate scalar and final hidden output coordinate lies in [-tau/2,tau/2] with joint probability at least 1-delta, by conditional spherical tails and an unconditional union bound. Exact flatness then gives full-jet transcript equality by induction.
oracle_realizations.information_to_error: Joint frame/seed probability of r_tan(xhat)>=Lp R^p/[8Bp16^(p-1)m^((3p-1)/2)] is at least 1-delta. Averaging gives some fixed frame with the same seed-only probability bound.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: Same feasible complete exact-jet oracle and one-call accounting.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: One frame reused throughout, not independently resampled gates or instances. Couple actual and simulated transcripts on the intersection of omitted-gate flatness events and the final-output slab event; do not condition spherical distributions on past success events.
